# Independent audit of capacitated flow balance and critical nonclosure

Audited source:
`candidate 8ac2ff347361aad9`.

**Result: PASS.** The capacity identity, finite elimination, and actual
R4 calibration are correct with their stated scopes. The root verifier
passes. An independent verifier additionally reconstructs every cap
signature from its actual affine inequality, parses the printed table,
checks the original 144-edge rational stress, and tests absorption with
both a transient self-loop and a deleted isolated loop:

`supporting computation verify_capacitated_flow_nonclosure_audit_defect_transport.py`

**464 exact checks PASS.** No correction is required.

## 1. Capacity and projected second moments

The source marginal of pi is mu and its target marginal is nu'<=nu.
The martingale identity is conditional at the source. Expanding the
quadratic therefore leaves exactly the nonnegative projected increment
energy plus the full unused-capacity second moment. Compact support
makes every integral finite. The matrix version follows entrywise.

Equality of projected source and full-capacity marginals includes equal
total mass; since pi has the source mass, this makes the unused measure
delta vanish. Equality of the remaining strictly convex second moment
then forces zero projected increments. The weaker formulation using
only equal masses and one quadratic moment is also valid. First moments
alone supply neither conclusion. For separately labeled transports the
nonnegative energies add; no cancellation is available.

## 2. Finite absorption, including every exceptional state

With a outgoing, b incoming, s=(a-b)_+, t=(b-a)_+, and
m=a+t=b+s, the row transition plus stop mass is exactly one whenever
m>0. The next-or-stopped point has mean p because the original outgoing
flow is barycentric. An injected source is s, not a or m.

A closed nonstopping communicating class has t=0 at every state and
row-stochastic transitions entirely within the class. Applying the
maximum principle to each coordinate makes all its bases equal.
Distinctness of P is essential and is explicitly assumed. The class
is therefore a singleton. Its loop equals its entire outgoing mass a.
The condition t=0 gives b<=a, whereas the loop itself gives b>=a;
hence b=a, injection s=0, and there is no outside incoming edge.
Deletion is consequently legitimate. A zero-m state has both incoming
and outgoing mass zero and carries no injection or stopping mass.

After these deletions, a state with no path to positive stopping would
reach a finite closed nonstopping class, contradicting its deletion.
Choosing one finite positive-probability stopping path per remaining
state and taking a finite minimum produces uniform N,epsilon>0.
The geometric tail proves certain absorption and convergence of the
matrix Green series. The identity m=s+mT then yields m=sG exactly.

Expected traversals equal the original f ON THE REMAINING FLOW. The
already deleted isolated loops are not traversed by injected mass, have
zero injection and terminal mass, and contribute zero to every convex
reward difference and to the increment energy. This is the scope of
the source's statement after deletion; it does not purport to realize
isolated positive loops from a zero source.

The terminal mass is t. For each injected start, the stopped coordinate
process is a bounded martingale; the geometric tail and boundedness
justify the terminal conditional-mean identity. Thus this really is a
martingale transport, rather than merely a source/sink mass balance.
Finite row/column subtraction gives equation (2), and rowwise Jensen
gives its sign. No integer first-exit point or residual-root Jensen
claim enters the proof.

## 3. R4 normalization and the table

I read the referenced exact R4 profile source. On each facet, high
profile is 2/3 and low profile is 1/3, while beta=40/93. Therefore

    high source density=(2/3)/beta=31/20=1+22/40,
    low source density=(1/3)/beta=31/40=1-9/40.

The saved rational transport has outgoing mass22 at every high tier
and incoming mass9 at every low tier, preserving all three coordinates
(z1,z2,tier). Dividing it by40 and adding the diagonal masses realizes
the actual transport from (W/beta)eta to the full eta. Its capacity is
completely used. The affine tier parametrization multiplies mass by
L/3 and preserves the physical continuous coordinate, so the stress
is genuinely physical and normal-preserving.

At a fixed base, mean W over the facet is 1/3+h_z/9. Multiplication
by1/beta and subtraction from one gives (27-31h_z)/120 exactly.
The independent verifier evaluates the ORIGINAL three affine cap
margins at t=1/6,1/2,5/6, rather than reusing the shortcut tier rule.
It matches the high/low JSON lists and every row of the printed table.
Mass and both first moments vanish; the quadratic totals are
1420,524,1420. The trace divided by120 is71/3, so every martingale with
these same marginals has strictly positive projected energy (71/3)L.

The conclusion is per fixed facet normal bundle. Other facet lengths
or simultaneous coordinate relabelings need not have the same displayed
matrix in the original base coordinates; no such claim is used.

## 4. Criticality and retained limitations

The all-normal certificate cited by the R4 source is the separate
dependency proving genuine global depth beta. The common cap masses
and section centroids alone are not used as a substitute. The example
is far above its OC target1/9 and is not asserted to be a bad attained
minimum.

Thus it rigorously refutes projected stationary closure from only
criticality, regularity, complete bases, common section centroids, and
normal-wise martingale stress. It neither proves nor refutes closure
from a further valid second-moment identity under stronger minimizing
hypotheses. The note correctly leaves that as a separate obligation.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
